name: list_my_posts
description: List the authenticated user's posts (articles and short posts), newest first.

name: get_post
description: Get one post's full markdown content by id. The caller's own posts are readable in any lifecycle state; other people's posts only when published and visible to the caller (public, or followers-only if the caller follows the author).

name: create_article
description: Create a new article (markdown) owned by the authenticated user. publishNow=false saves a draft; otherwise the article enters the same submit/review pipeline as the web editor (pre-submit keyword gate → pending_review → the moderation plugin publishes or queues review).

boardId.description: Board to submit to (required when publishNow; must be a board created by the admins)

topics.description: Official topic names of that board (1-3 when publishNow); unknown names are ignored. Topics are admin-created only

announce.description: Admin tokens only: also publish as a site-wide announcement (every user gets a system notification when it publishes). Non-admin tokens are rejected.

name: update_post
description: Update an existing post's title/content/summary (must be owned by the caller). Editing a published post re-enters the moderation pipeline (status goes back to pending_review, same as the web editor).

name: delete_post
description: Move one of the authenticated user's posts to the recycle bin (soft delete, restorable from the web UI). Posts already in the recycle bin are reported as not found.

name: search_posts
description: Search published posts across the platform by keyword (title + body).

name: get_feed
description: Browse the community feed (recent published public posts and short posts).

name: list_my_media
description: List the authenticated user's media library (WebP images).

name: delete_media
description: Delete a media file from the authenticated user's library (removes the library row and the underlying file).

name: list_post_comments
description: List comments on a post (only comments the caller may see).

name: get_profile
description: Get the authenticated user's profile.

name: get_stats
description: Get the authenticated user's content statistics.

name: list_boards
description: List active community boards with their posting policy. Use it to find the boardId required by create_article.

name: list_board_topics
description: List the active official topics of one board (by slug). The candidates for create_article's topics argument (1-3 must belong to the submitted board).

name: domains_list
description: List the authenticated user's subdomains with optional search/filter/sort. Returns domain DTOs (fqdn, status, nameservers, DNSSEC state, expiry) and the total count.

q.description: fuzzy match on label (unicode or ASCII form)

name: domains_suffixes
description: List the public suffix catalog open for registration (per-suffix label length rules, price tiers in points, DNSSEC availability) plus the registration meta: whether registration is currently enabled, the per-transaction year limit, the grace period (days) and the points unit (unitName/unit).

name: domains_check
description: Check whether a label is available for registration under a suffix (no side effects). Reserved labels report available=false with reason="reserved"; the provider-side check is best-effort (providerChecked=false means the local registry answer only).

label.description: label to register (unicode or ASCII form)

name: domains_get
description: Get one of the authenticated user's domains by id: domain DTO, the recent delegation sync job history (provider push attempts and errors) and the transfer overview (active transfer code expiry / pending incoming request, aligned with the REST detail route; null when the overview query fails). Not-found for domains owned by others.

name: domain_register
description: Register a subdomain under a suffix and charge points (idempotency: concurrent duplicate registrations are rejected server-side; failures roll back the charge). Registration must be enabled site-wide; per-user quota and balance are enforced. Nameservers are required (2-4 hostnames; predefined provider sets or custom) UNLESS the suffix forbids external NS (externalNsForbidden) — such suffixes are wired to site DNS hosting automatically at registration; passing nameservers to them is rejected.

label.description: label to register (unicode or ASCII form)

years.description: registration term in years (1-3, site policy cap)

dsRecords.description: DS records for DNSSEC. Only allowed when dnssecEnabled=true (cleared automatically when DNSSEC is off).

name: domain_update_ns
description: Update the desired delegation state (nameservers / DNSSEC / DS records) of one of the caller's active domains. Omitted fields keep their current value; at least one field is required. Disabling DNSSEC clears all DS records. The change is queued for provider sync (idempotent convergence); expired domains cannot be updated.

dsRecords.description: DS records for DNSSEC. Only allowed when dnssecEnabled=true (cleared automatically when DNSSEC is off).

name: domain_renew
description: Renew one of the caller's domains by N years and charge points (max 10 years from now after renewal; renewing inside the grace period revives an expired domain). Pass requestId (any uuid) to make retries idempotent: the same requestId never double-charges or double-extends.

requestId.description: client intent idempotency key for retries

name: dns_zones
description: List your DNS hosting zones (per-zone record counts, sync status, delegation state). Read-only.

name: dns_zone_get
description: Get one DNS zone panel: zone summary (status, driver, sync state, DNSSEC) plus all records. Read-only; non-owned ids return 404.

name: dns_zone_create
description: Create a DNS hosting zone for a site-registered domain (domainId) or an external domain (externalFqdn, exactly one of the two). Mutating; consumes the per-user zone quota; the zone is provisioned on a hosting node and delegation is wired automatically for site domains.

name: dns_zone_delete
description: Delete a DNS hosting zone (destructive, irreversible): resolution stops immediately and all records are wiped from the node and the site. The domain itself is unaffected; re-add hosting anytime via dns_zone_create.

name: dns_record_create
description: Create a DNS record (A/AAAA/CNAME/ALIAS/MX/TXT/SRV/CAA/PTR/SVCB/HTTPS/TLSA/DNAME) in your zone. Mutating; conflicts (CNAME coexistence), per-zone record quota and per-type validation are enforced server-side.

name: dns_record_update
description: Update one of your DNS records (type/name/content/ttl/disabled/meta; at least one field). Mutating.

name: dns_record_delete
description: Delete one of your DNS records. Mutating.

name: dns_records_import
description: Bulk-import records from an RFC 1035 zone file (max 256 KB). System records (SOA/NS/DS/DNSSEC) are skipped; capacity/conflict warnings are reported per line without aborting the batch. Mutating.

name: dns_zone_dnssec
description: Enable or disable DNSSEC signing for your zone (DS propagation to the parent delegation is handled server-side). Mutating.

name: dns_zone_verify
description: Check public NS delegation for a pending (external) zone and activate it when delegation is satisfied. Idempotent; returns the new status.

name: dns_zone_export
description: Export your zone as an RFC 1035 zone file. Read-only.

name: dns_events
description: Recent activity timeline of your zone (create/record/dnssec/billing... events, newest first). Read-only.

name: dns_pricing
description: DNS hosting plan disclosure: monthly price, days remaining this month, prorated first-month estimate, zone quota usage. Read-only.

name: domain_transfer_create_code
description: Generate a transfer code for one of the caller's active domains. The plaintext code is returned exactly once in this response (only its hash is stored) and is also emailed to the owner. Store it now. Regenerating revokes the previous code and cancels its pending incoming transfer requests. Code expires in 7 days.

name: domain_transfer_revoke_code
description: Revoke a domain's active transfer code and cancel its pending transfer requests (recipient is notified). Idempotent: revoking when no active code exists succeeds silently.

name: domain_transfer_request
description: Request the transfer of a domain to the caller using a transfer code obtained from its current owner. After the transfer completes the domain is hosted on the platform's managed DNS (custom nameservers are not accepted during transfers). An OTP is emailed to the current owner. The caller must ask them for it (the OTP never appears in tool output or logs). Wrong codes consume attempts and lock the code after 5 failures; the transfer completes only via domain_transfer_confirm.

fqdn.description: full domain to transfer (unicode or ASCII form)

code.description: transfer code from the current owner (XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX)

name: domain_transfer_resend_otp
description: Resend the transfer OTP to the current owner's email (recipient's own pending request only). Resending issues a new OTP, resets its 10-minute TTL and clears the attempt counter.

name: domain_transfer_confirm
description: Complete a domain transfer by submitting the 6-digit OTP the current owner received by email. On success the domain changes ownership immediately, lands on the platform's managed DNS hosting, and DNSSEC is cleared (trust anchors do not survive a transfer). Wrong/expired OTPs consume attempts; the request locks after 5 failures.

otp.description: 6-digit code from the current owner's email

name: domain_transfer_my_requests
description: List the caller's pending incoming transfer requests (domains being transferred to them, awaiting OTP confirmation).

name: search_public_posts
description: Search published public posts by keyword (title + body), newest first. Ghost (federated) authors are excluded. Public endpoint: no auth required, rate-limited. `q` is required and must be non-empty.

name: search_topics
description: Search active official topics (hashtags) by keyword in name/description. Public endpoint: no auth required, rate-limited. `q` is required and must be non-empty.

name: search_boards
description: Search active community boards by keyword in name/description. Public endpoint: no auth required, rate-limited. `q` is required and must be non-empty.

name: search_users
description: Search active community members by username/display-name keyword. Anti-enumeration: at most 10 results, no pagination, public profile fields only (username, display name, ghost flag). Public endpoint: no auth required, rate-limited. `q` is required and must be non-empty.

name: search_comments
description: Search visible comments on published public posts by keyword; each hit carries a short excerpt around the match, never the private floors. Public endpoint: no auth required, rate-limited. `q` is required and must be non-empty.

name: search_everything
description: Run all five public searches (posts, topics, boards, users, comments) in parallel and return each type's top hits in one call. Public endpoint: no auth required, rate-limited. `q` is required and must be non-empty.
